description: Research how to get more from the peasants without breaking their backs. A strong economy is a strong barony.
Research how to craft stronger weapons and armor for the troops.
Where the Rana share and develop new skills for life in the Marsh.
Studying the runes in the pyramid brings knowledge of the wars Rana fought in the past, and how to use that knowledge now.
Research dedicated to the fine points of increasing wealth and trade.
The fine points of casting metal and working ores leads to greater weapons and creations.
Research of the past unlocks methods for more efficient production and resource recovery.
Study, devotion and labour leads to research that improves the troops of Aurelia.
Research how to improve income and troop sizes of the Vanir.
Research how the weapons and armor of the Vanir can be worthy of their deeds.
Research essence, income and troops sizes of the Roots.
Research improvements for Vessels and troops of the Roots.
Research economy and troop sizes. Careful record keeping and precise paperwork lead to victory.
One must always be prepared for war, research that improves the troops improves the outcome of the war.
